title: Wait on CI without polling, and stop pr-loop's blocked run-cancel step
notes:
From the 30-session retro (2026-11-16):
- 166 manual `gh pr view` / `gh pr checks` polls in a single new-crm manager session.
- `sleep N; gh pr checks` was blocked 6 times across the dashboard and new-crm, because foreground sleep is blocked.
- pr-loop's `gh run cancel` step was blocked by the auto-mode classifier as "Interfere With Workloads", and 5 sessions tried it.

Want:
- one documented way to wait: `gh pr checks <n> --watch` with run_in_background, or a small ci-wait script under Monitor. Name it in the pr-loop skill and in the landing prompt in src/main/ship/review.ts.
- Drop the `gh run cancel` step from pr-loop, since the draft flag already keeps CI from running, or get the user to allow it.

comments.body: Scope from main-dashboard: change only this repo (the landing and review prompts in src/main/ship/review.ts, and any ci-wait script here). Do NOT edit the pr-loop skill: it lives in the user's dotfiles and serves other projects, and the user said to leave it alone. Put the proposed pr-loop change (drop gh run cancel; name the wait) in the PR description for the user. review.ts changed in #291 (autoMerge); merge origin/main first. Do not bump the version.
